messages.subject: Stop/cancel Shiny App deployment?
parts:
Hello everybody.

I registered at www.shinyapps.io and installed all the packages and used the written tutorial as guidance to deploy a shiny app. I tried o call the help to the function "deployApp()"  to look up the arguments but accidentally started the deployment of my working directory. I immediately hit the stop button in the RStudio console, but since then the application is listed as pending on the www.shinyapps.io and I cannot find a way to cancel and delete it?

Thank you very much in advance.

KK

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Stop/cancel Shiny App deployment?
parts:
You can call 

terminateApp("appname") 

If that doesn't work, or gives an error let me know.

-Andy
